title: Implement code.search_symbols MCP Tool
description: Implement the code.search_symbols MCP tool. Search for code symbols (functions, classes, methods, interfaces) by name across the project. Filter by kind and language. Return matches ordered by exact match first, then exported symbols, then by name.
acceptance_criteria: MCP tool code.search_symbols accepts query (string), optional kind, optional language
Returns array of symbol objects with name, qualified_name, kind, file_path, start_line, end_line, is_exported
Exact name matches ranked first, then prefix matches, then substring matches
Supports pagination with limit (default 20) and offset
Query completes in less than 100ms for 500K symbols
Unit test: seed 10 symbols then verify ordering rules
